open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending confirmation inputs
open_points.text: `business_confidential` | every other fact of every model ... the owner session, but for its uploaded import file` conflicts with `the inputs it is bound to` because an import confirmation can bind display names, customer names, tax ids and other `personal_data` values
open_points.question: What disclosure class applies to personal-data inputs bound into a pending import confirmation, and does the pending confirmation store those values or only a non-personal reference to the uploaded file?
options: Store the input values and classify each such value as `personal_data`
Store only a business-confidential digest or opaque reference to the uploaded file
Classify the entire pending confirmation as `personal_data` whenever any bound input is personal
open_points.default_guess: Store only a business-confidential digest or opaque reference to the separately `personal_data` uploaded file.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession confirmation identity
open_points.text: `at most one pending confirmation — its one-time value ... made when a confirmation step is shown` conflicts or overlaps ambiguously with `Registry mints a confirmation id when the owner confirms an action` and `The confirmation id ... is minted per confirmation`
open_points.question: Is the pending confirmation's one-time value the confirmation id, and exactly when is that identifier minted?
options: They are the same identifier, minted when the confirmation step is shown
They are distinct values: a challenge is minted when shown and a confirmation id is minted only when successfully confirmed
They are the same identifier, but it is minted only when the confirmation is submitted
open_points.default_guess: Treat them as distinct: mint a one-time challenge when the step is shown and mint the audited confirmation id only when the confirmed action is accepted.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession last-request instant
open_points.text: `changed by the owner's requests ... the instant of its last request`
open_points.question: Which owner-interface requests change the last-request instant?
options: Every authenticated request in the owner session, including reads and confirmation-page displays
Only product actions that create or change domain state
Only the State 2 actions A13 and A16 referenced here
open_points.default_guess: Move it on every authenticated owner-interface request handled through the session.

open_points.subject: OwnerSession pending confirmation lifecycle
open_points.question: When is a pending confirmation considered used and cleared if submission is invalid, stale, or the confirmed product action is refused?
options: On any submission of its one-time value, regardless of outcome
Only after the one-time value is valid, even if the product action is then refused
Only when the confirmed product action is accepted
open_points.default_guess: Clear it once a valid one-time value is submitted, even if a later product precondition refuses the action.
